london_boutique_keeper.text: Welcome to Carnaby Street. We were fashionable in the sixties and have been quietly smug ever since.

then.text: Is that your {worn_coat}? Darling, take it off. No, I'm joking, keep it. It's lovely.
The {worn_hat}: bold. Very you. I'd say it was brave but we don't use that word here.
I do like that {worn_top}. It says you have somewhere better to be.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Dressed for a day out, I see. We can fix that, gently.

london_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
